purpose: Diagnose whether Draw occurrence is stably concentrated near the center of a learned A-D-H latent strength axis across time-ordered competition-season folds, using all existing repository data rather than consuming another random fixed100 sample.

folding.season_order: ascending by the minimum match date observed for each competition-season
folding.train_rule: for each test competition-season, train only same-competition rows with match date strictly before the minimum date of that test season

latent_axis.standardization: median/IQR fitted on training fold only
latent_axis.regression: ridge least squares with unpenalized intercept

centrality_definition.central_band: symmetric quantile band around the training fitted-score median with total training coverage equal to the training Draw rate: q_low=(1-pD_train)/2 and q_high=(1+pD_train)/2
centrality_definition.deciles: training fitted-score decile cutpoints; test rows are assigned using those frozen cutpoints

primary_structural_gate.pooled_central_draw_lift: pooled test Draw rate inside central band minus pooled test Draw rate outside central band >= 0.03
primary_structural_gate.fold_sign_stability: at least 60% of eligible folds have positive central-band Draw lift
primary_structural_gate.competition_sign_stability: at least 60% of competitions represented by at least two eligible folds have positive pooled central-band Draw lift
primary_structural_gate.central_decile_shape: pooled Draw rate in central deciles 5-6 exceeds pooled Draw rate in outer deciles 1-2 and 9-10 by >= 0.02
primary_structural_gate.axis_direction_sanity: pooled H rate in top 30% exceeds bottom 30% by >=0.20 and pooled A rate in bottom 30% exceeds top 30% by >=0.20
primary_structural_gate.if_pass: Centrality is a stable structural Draw mechanism worthy of a separately preregistered model; this diagnostic itself has formal_weight=0.
primary_structural_gate.if_fail: Do not keep pursuing generic central-band Draw models on the current feature family.
